text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin by 1.1 points, suggesting some rotation into altcoin interest despite extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 23 reflects capitulation sentiment, yet the slight upward trend over the past week hints at potential stabilization rather than accelerating panic. Bitcoin's 56.3% dominance and $65B daily volume indicate the market is maintaining structural liquidity even as risk appetite remains severely compressed.
